Constructed from the same substantial bull hide nubuck leather as the collaborative Fasan footwear, the jacket combines Paraboot's heritage in durable, functional footwear with Norse Projects' approach to understated, purposeful design.

products.title: Norse Moon Merino Lambswool Scarf
products.body_html:
A lambswool scarf developed and woven by Abraham Moon in the UK. The style is offered in classic as well as seasonal colours. 

Founded in 1837, Abraham Moon is one of the last vertical mills in the UK with a reputation for consistent quality and innovation. Moon develops the fabric from raw wool to dyeing, blending, carding, spinning, warping, weaving, and finally finishing the fabrics. Ensuring quality and consistency few other mills can achieve.

products.title: Norse Standard Heavy Loose LS T-shirt
products.body_html:
The Norse Standard Heavy Loose LS T-Shirt, a timeless menswear archetype instilled with intent and efficacy.

Designed in Denmark, and meticulously assembled in Europe, the Norse Standard Loose LS T-shirt takes its inspiration from the 1940s crew neck t-shirt. These undershirts of the early-days were commonly made from cheap single cotton jersey, with a simple cut and sew construction and ribbed collar, making them easily accessible to produce for the mass consumer. The fit relaxed compared to its undergarment counterpart, as it was no longer necessary to fit snuggly beneath uniforms. The t-shirt’s versatility also lends itself as the ideal venue for a graphic, often used in military outfitting to depict a soldiers regiment.

The t-shirt will accompany your daily outfits with comfort and performance. It is loose fitting style finished with a ribbed collar and twin needle stitched hem and cuffs.

This edition of the Thiers by Paraboot for Norse Projects pays tribute to the Kanonbådsskure — the historic gunboat hangars in Copenhagen’s Holmen district. Built in 1820 to store Royal Danish Navy vessels, these timber-framed buildings now house architecture studios and the Norse Projects design studio. Based on a 1960s Paraboot silhouette, the design is re-iterated with leather laces and the “Rocade” outsole — a lightweight rubber sole made in France, carefully selected from the Paraboot archives. products.title: NP Ravn
products.body_html:
The Ravn by Paraboot for Norse Projects introduces a new silhouette informed by Paraboot’s classic hiking lineage and built for everyday urban use. Crafted from tumbled full-grain leather, the shoe places emphasis on structure, proportion and durability. It features the lightweight “Rocade” outsole made in France, offering dependable traction with a reduced profile suited to city environments. The upper is constructed with tumbled full-grain leather, flat waxed cotton laces and exposed Blake stitching at the midsole. Suede is positioned at the heel tab and tongue for grip and comfort when putting the shoe on. A leather and EVA midsole provides structure and comfort, while the unpadded collar maintains a clean silhouette. The result is a robust all-leather shoe that remains true to Paraboot’s design language while aligning naturally with the Norse Projects point of view.
